name: Accusation False
overview: Scripture clearly condemns false accusation as unrighteous and harmful, urging believers not to raise false reports or align with the wicked in bearing untrue witness (Exodus 23:1). The Lord commands His people to avoid false matters that could destroy the innocent, emphasizing His refusal to justify the wicked (Exodus 23:7). Illustrative incidents such as Potiphar's wife falsely accusing Joseph (Genesis 39:7) and Joseph himself accusing his brethren of spying (Genesis 42:9) demonstrate the destructive impact of false claims. Additionally, the rebellion against Moses by Korah (Numbers 16:3) reveals how wrongful accusations can challenge God's appointed leaders, underscoring the need for integrity and truthfulness among God's people.
